name: Aura Of Experience
description:
Allies within short range of you get +1d to attack rolls.

Additionally, for each different Culture of origin among the weapons and armor you are wielding or wearing, your base MP increases by 1, up to 5 additional MP.

Describe your presence on the battlefield.

improvements.name: Inspiring
improvements.description: Whenever you roll 🌞 on an attack roll, an ally within short range may spend a reaction to make a melee attack.

improvements.name: Put Your Backs Into It
improvements.description: Allies within short range may spend 2 Endurance before making an attack roll. If they do and land a hit, +1d to the damage roll.
